projectDescription: A browser-based map editor for SkillTanki — a TypeScript/PlayCanvas port of the original 2010 AIR level editor — letting you place props, define spawn points and bonus regions, and export game-ready Tanks XML maps without installing anything.
keyFeatures: Full prop palette with 11 libraries (Buildings, Builds, Castle, Complex Build, Elements, Land, Landscape, kahgel, kariz, yonje, zamin)
53 classic summer maps openable by URL (?map=<id>) or file picker
Functional props (spawn points, bonus regions, CTF flags) fully round-trip through import/export
Occupancy grid snap with conflict detection (Q selects conflicting props)
Undo/redo via event journal covering add, delete, copy, move, rotate, and texture change
Collision view renders box/plane/triangle primitives extracted from .3ds meshes
Exports game-ready Tanks XML with correct collision geometry including triangles
Reads and writes the original AIR editor's binary .lvl format
No install, no account — runs fully in a desktop browser from a static build
Production bundle minified with terser and obfuscated; assets served from Cloudflare R2
publicApiSurface: exportTanksXml(props, options) — builds the full map XML string
exportLvl(props) — encodes the editor's native binary .lvl format
importLvl(buffer, resolve) — parses a .lvl file into Prop[]
importTanksXml(mapXml, options) — parses a Tanks map XML into Prop[]
EditorDocument.addProp(prop, addToMap?) — adds a prop to the scene and occupancy grid
EditorDocument.deleteProps(props?) — removes props from scene and grid
EditorDocument.undo() / redo() — traverses the event journal
EditorDocument.toXml() / toLvl() — serialise the current document
EditorDocument.loadXml(mapXml, onParsed?) — imports a Tanks XML into the document
EditorDocument.loadLvl(buffer, onParsed?) — imports a .lvl file into the document
EditorCamera.orbit(deltaYawDeg, deltaPitchDeg) — rotates the orbit camera
EditorCamera.pan(dxUnits, dyUnits) — pans the orbit target
PropRenderer.loadLibraries(entries) — fetches and parses all prop library XMLs
PropRenderer.attach(prop, parent) — builds a PlayCanvas entity for a prop
PropRenderer.applyTexture(prop) — swaps the active texture variant
Prop class — data model with kind, library, group, name, x/y/z, rotationZ, textureName, free, hidden
window.__editor — debug/tooling handle exposing app, doc, editorCamera, renderer, simRoot and helpers
